def: to pass the night (properly, in the open air)

occurrences.text: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.
And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
